source_card_revisions.revised_conclusion: Useful synthesis-design hypothesis and domain boundary; no evidence yet for out-of-sample prediction, room realism, perceptual preference, or production readiness.
method_limits: Numerical nRMSE screening threshold not reported
No rejection count by source library or source-stratified sampling
All descriptors calculated on resynthesised rather than original IRs
PCA and IRLS diagnostics are fit on the retained corpus
No held-out set, cross-validation, external corpus, or confidence interval described
Generated preset placement is a range check in the same descriptor space, not independent validation
Mode count remapped to 1000-8000 for compute
Random phase and frequency jitter require deterministic seed control
Early-reflection shape is a fixed corpus-mean 256-tap FIR template

knowledge_cards.claim: R2rob on IRLS inliers from the fitted corpus is an in-sample fit diagnostic, not held-out accuracy.
Descriptors extracted from resynthesis evaluate the chosen representation internally and do not independently establish preservation of the original IR.
Projection of generated presets into their construction descriptor space is a range check, not independent perceptual validation.
Scaling one mean early FIR changes early-late energy but not room-specific early-reflection geometry.
Random phase and diffusion jitter are uncontrolled A/B factors unless seed and mode bank are frozen.
A corpus amplitude constant absorbed by output normalization is not a transferable gain setting.

rule_revisions.change: Vary one early-late energy control without regenerating the mode bank
rule_revisions.range_origin: central corpus-supported region; normalized 0-1 p5-p95 map is not a recommendation
rule_revisions.verification: Wet diagnostics plus randomized BS.1770-matched full-mix A/B and Dmitry preference
rule_revisions.cancel_when: Any stochastic mismatch, artifact, masking, image instability, or loudness-only preference

rule_revisions.constraint: Use only when a hard gate is intentionally retained; do not introduce a gate where the project baseline is no gate.

experiment_revisions.stage_1_match: Match A/B reverb-feed integrated loudness within 0.1 LU; retain unmatched raw renders
experiment_revisions.stage_2_match: Independently match final excerpts within 0.1 LU integrated under BS.1770
experiment_revisions.listening: Randomized labels; three repeats per verse and chorus; repeats measure one-listener consistency and do not increase independent n
experiment_revisions.success: B consistently preferred in both sections after both matches with no protected-quality regression
experiment_revisions.cancel: Preference vanishes after matching, or pumping, wash, masking, image change, or headroom loss appears

new_experiments.single_factor: Early-late energy ratio within the central corpus range
requirements: public licensed revision or approved local prototype
new_experiments.cancel: Identical-setting null test fails or early-late change cannot be separated from global wet level
